open_points.subject: randomly minted record identities
open_points.text: `trial_execution_id` M07, `binding_id` M11, `run_id` M19, `approval_id` M24 and `grant_id` M25 are minted at random by the kernel; one that already exists is minted again.
open_points.question: Which module owns the randomness, collision checking and atomic minting of these identities, and which modules may depend on that capability?
options: a new lower-level identifier/randomness module mints them and `store` checks uniqueness
each record-owning module mints its own identities
open_points.default_guess: Have `store` mint them atomically because uniqueness depends on stored records.

open_points.subject: start-time cleanup of unreferenced value bytes
open_points.text: On start, temporary files, value bytes no record names (left by a failed call, K-10; owner, 2026-10-07) and the spool directories of runs that ended and do not keep their spool (A14) are removed; nothing else is.
open_points.question: Which State 3 module and startup step remove content-addressed value bytes that no record names?
options: `store.open_store` removes them while inspecting its records
a separate store-maintenance startup capability removes them
open_points.default_guess: Make this part of `store.open_store`, since only `store` may inspect persistence and touch the data directory.

open_points.subject: mapped operation output values and classes
open_points.text: A value list is one StoredValue, the JSON array of the elements' values in element order, [...] written by `runs` when the list is first delivered [...] / `runs` for flow inputs and function outputs, values and files alike [...] `effects` for service outputs, values and files alike
open_points.question: For a mapped operation node, which module owns creation and disclosure-class assignment of the aggregate output list, including the empty-list case where no service invocation occurs?
options: `runs` owns every mapped aggregate as a run-derived value
`effects` owns aggregates from operation nodes and exposes them to `runs`
`runs` persists the aggregate but `effects` supplies its class and value facts
open_points.default_guess: Let `runs` own the aggregate and its class because mapping, empty-map execution and aggregate delivery are run mechanics.

open_points.subject: pinned dependency versions
open_points.text: The pinned Python dependencies and sandbox runtime of A20 rule 3 are a release artifact built and checked outside the running kernel; at run time only `sandbox.probe_sandbox` checks that a sandbox works.
open_points.question: What module or named build artifact owns the authoritative dependency list and exact versions, and what may the runtime modules know about it?
options: a specified release manifest outside the runtime module graph
`sandbox` owns the runtime dependency pins while the application package owns the rest
open_points.default_guess: Use one authoritative release manifest outside the runtime graph and make the build verify it.
